rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=12, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=123, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, n_iter=400, outer_wall_s=1200, lr=0.0023, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=7, proj_kernel=7, img_kernel=5, proj_sx=1.0, proj_sy=2.0, proj_sr=0.02, img_sx=1.5, img_sy=1.5, img_sr=0.02, rationale=iter-9: VARIANCE-CHECK probe. ONE knob changed vs the iter-8 hr-0.4222 PEAK/champion config (val_n 6->12); all 18 other fields held IDENTICAL to demo_dl_dual_domain_bilateral_n2i_iter_08.json (seed=123, img_n_bf=7, img_sr=0.02 LOOSE demo-correct, n_iter=400, pretrain_epochs=3, lr=2.3e-3, grad_clip=1.0, warm_start=True). val_n is a genuinely NEW axis -- pinned at 6 across iters 1-8. Read iters 6->8 BY HEADROOM (campaign primary, PSNR/noise-sensitive on demo): iter-6 img_n_bf=7 seed=42 hr 0.3330 (PSNR 20.18); iter-7 n_iter 400->800 seed=42 hr 0.3346 (PSNR 20.19, per-scan Adam budget DEAD FLAT); iter-8 seed 42->123 hr 0.4222 BUT PSNR DROPPED to 17.81 and SSIM dipped 0.7796->0.7711. FAILURE MODE at hr~0.42: the headroom estimate is HIGH-VARIANCE across the tiny val_n=6 draw. A pure seed change (iter-8) swung hr +0.089 (0.333->0.422) while PSNR fell -2.4 dB and SSIM fell -0.0085 -- hr and PSNR moved in OPPOSITE directions, which a genuine reconstruction improvement cannot do. The hr jump is therefore an EASIER 6-scene val draw (weaker LD-FBP baseline inflating the headroom fraction (metric-baseline)/(oracle-baseline)), NOT a real lift. iter-8 pre-registered exactly this next step: If hr instead swings widely, the ceiling is split-sensitive and val_n should be raised next to tighten the estimate. HYPOTHESIS (the variance hypothesis): doubling val_n 6->12 tightens the hr estimate; if hr 0.4222 was a lucky-split artifact it regresses toward the ~0.36-0.39 midpoint of the two single-split readings (0.333 & 0.422), and PSNR recovers toward ~19 dB as the larger draw re-includes harder scenes. If instead hr stays ~0.42 at val_n=12, the lift is real and seed-123s draw was representative -- either way the campaigns reported demo-bilateral number is de-noised. Chose val_n over (a) img_n_bf/n_iter (both DEAD FLAT, exhausted at seed=42), (b) img_sr (exhausted + substrate-confirmed WRONG-direction: tightening to 0.0005 collapsed hr 0.3335->0.1998 at iter-4 -- do NOT repeat), (c) proj_n_bf (symmetry trap, wasted params), (d) lr/grad_clip/warm_start/pretrain_epochs (untried but not yet motivated -- the iter-8 PSNR-vs-hr divergence makes VARIANCE the named open question, and val_n is its direct test). Held fixed at iter-8 PEAK values: seed=123, img_n_bf=7, img_sr=0.02 (LOOSE, demo-correct), n_iter=400, proj_n_bf=1, kernels (proj_k=7/img_k=5), proj sigmas (1.0/2.0/0.02), img spatial sigmas (img_sx=1.5/img_sy=1.5), lr=2.3e-3, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, grad_clip=1.0. Wall: iter-8 ran 345 s at val_n=6/n_iter=400; doubling val_n roughly doubles the per-scene fit portion -> est ~600-700 s, well under the 1200 s outer_wall_s internal guard and the 1800 s sbatch wall (under the 15-min budget). This iter DOCUMENTS whether the hr~0.42 champion is a real lift or a val-split artifact, toward iter-20. PER-IMAGE bilateral N2I, AGENT4CT_DATASET=phantoms; do NOT revert to amortized.
